model.name: addFolder.routeByParentPhysicality
model.description: Add-folder resolves the parent; if it has a physical dir -> physical create; if NOT (a virtual/model Folder) -> model-store create. Both paths exist; the endpoint branches instead of forcing every add through the physical path. A malformed non-Folder ref still fail-closes to bad-parent-loc.
model.note: Architect wires the routing branch Class/Method (design 5cfa4f9dd) on build-go; expert builds; tester gates member-session @390 + malformed-ref fail-closed stub + delete-harmless-comment.
